name: VC Dimension / Antichain Number
witness_verification: On the quadratic-residue tournament classes, antichain number is exactly 1 (value 1072), while VC is Theta(log_2 p) as primes p congruent to 3 modulo 4 tend to infinity (value 1123). The latter proof uses the signed extension theorem with its explicit numerical hypothesis. Thus VC/AN tends to infinity, refuting every reverse affine bound. No conclusion is inferred solely from a finite tournament computation.
details: For every finite binary class, the antichain number is at most VC dimension.
proof: Theorem 33 of Simon--Telle records the theorem of Mansouri--Simon--Singla--Zilles that every finite concept class admits an antichain teacher mapping whose sample sizes are at most its VC dimension.
proof_source: Theorem 33 of Simon--Telle, MAP-and MLE-Based Teaching.
